newsitem.title: USA: American Phoenix in Chinese joint venture.
newsitem.headline: American Phoenix in Chinese joint venture.

text.p: American Phoenix Group Inc said Monday its wholly owned subsidiary Tetherless Access Asia Ltd has a memorandum of understanding with Rayes Group Co Ltd to establish a wireless network communications joint venture in China.
Tetherless will own 51 percent of the venture and will use its wireless network hardware and software to link Chinese companies into Rayes Group's existing national internet backbone network.
Rayes Group is a Chinese company that operates as China On-Line, or COL, American Phoenix said.
Consummation of the agreement depends on the completion of a feasibility study, a definitive joint venture agreement, and formal approval by the Chinese government, the company said.
Tetherless Access, or TAL, will invest $5 million in the venture and will install its networks in 10 of the 108 cities where COL currently operates or is installing systems.

The company said it aims to roll out the network in the 108 cities by the first quarter of 1997 and to get over 10,000 customers to pay recurrent fees equivalent to those charged by wireline services.
American Phoenix also said it will change its name to TAL Wireless Networks Inc and consolidate its corporate headquarters operations in Sunnyvale, Calif.
